title: 겹받침 연음: 읽어요, 앉아요, 값이
objective: By the end, you can read words with a double final consonant (겹받침) before a vowel, such as 읽어요 [일거요].
summary: Learn how a double final consonant splits and links to the next vowel, as in 읽어요 [일거요].

task.title: Read and say it right
task.line: Split the double final consonant, move the second one to the next vowel, then write or choose the sound.

letters.sound: 읽어요 [일거요]: the first consonant stays and the second moves to the vowel. (Exception: in ㄶ and ㅀ, the ㅎ is silent before a vowel, so ㄴ/ㄹ moves instead: 싫어요 [시러요], 끓여요 [끄려요].)
앉아요 [안자요]: ㄴ stays and ㅈ moves to the vowel.
값이 [갑씨]: ㅅ moves over and becomes a strong ㅆ.

exercises: Choose the correct sound: ① 닭이 — [다기] / [달기] ② 넓어요 — [널버요] / [너버요] ③ 싫어요 — [실허요] / [시러요]
Write the sound in [ ]: ① 밝아요 ② 젊어요 ③ 값을
Which consonant moves to the next syllable? ① 앉으세요 ② 읽으세요 ③ 끓여요
Write the sound of the word in ( ): ① 오늘은 하늘이 (맑아요). ② 돈이 (없으면) 못 사요. ③ 손에 (흙이) 묻었어요.
answers: ① ㅈ [안즈세요] ② ㄱ [일그세요] ③ ㄹ — ㅎ is silent [끄려요]
